description: Department of Inland Revenue - Notice in relation to specific provision for a debt claim made by a person conducting a banking business
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal notice issued under Section 66 of the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017. It specifies provisions for debt claims in accordance with directives from the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. The content involves regulatory matters and the implementation of specific legal provisions from an existing Act, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While it names an individual (the Commissioner General), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than a personnel appointment or government restructuring, so government classification types (1-3) do not take precedence.
